name: Galdós
address: Calle Ramiro de Maeztu, Madrid, Madrid 28040
about:
Welcome to University City! Galdós is situated just a short walk from two of Madrid’s largest institutions. You are just a 15 minute walk from the Universidad Complutense de Madrid (UCM), Universidad Politécnica is even closer and CUNEF just infront of us!
Galdos offers comfortable housing for more than 300 students, with easy transport links to the whole of Madrid. The Plaza De Espana is a short metro ride away. From there you can explore all of the sites and sounds of the capital city.
Want to unwind after a day on campus? Spend the late afternoon relaxing in our private gardens. This outdoor space is exclusive to our residents. Let your stress go in one of the sun loungers or just take ten minutes to sit in nature.
Want to work away from the noise of campus? Take use of our study spaces. Everyone at Galdos can study here in private at any time of day. Prefer to work with others? You can invite guests over to share the space and study together.
The property has secure entrances and exits, so only residents can get in or out unless guests are invited in. You can trust that your belongings are well-protected whilst you stay with us. All residents also get three meals a day, free super-fast WiFi and access to all communal spaces in the building.
Get the perfect balance of city convenience, excellent transport, and tranquil green retreats at Galdós. Plus, you’re a short walk from campus. You couldn’t find anywhere better!

name: Nido Aravaca
address: Av. del Talgo 3, Madrid, Madrid 28023
about:
Nido is located in the iconic Aravaca neighbourhood, known for its vibrant culture, lively food scene and charming architecture. With great transport links, you’re just a short ride or walk, bike or cercanías train from Madrid’s main universities, hotspots and student hangouts. Basically, everything you need is right on your doorstep.
Home to over 500 students, Nido Aravaca offers plenty of spaces designed for studying, socialising and switching off. There’s a fully equipped gym, games room, study areas, a cosy private dining room perfect for hosting friends or family, and an impressive rooftop lounge with views to match.
Room cleaning and linen change every two weeks are included in your rent, along with access to laundry facilities, parking and outdoor terraces. There’s also a fantastic DoEat restaurant in the building — grab a coffee, a snack or sign up for a half or full board plan.
Whether you’re relaxing in the rooftop jacuzzi or watching a film in the games room, Nido Aravaca has everything you need to make the most of uni life.

name: Nido Príncipe Pío
address: Paseo de la Florida, Madrid, Madrid 28008
about:
Welcome to Nido Príncipe Pío, your university home in the centre of Madrid! Where history comes to life in its cobbled streets, and the energy and vitality of its squares invite you to immerse yourself in a unique blend of culture and modernity.
Strategically located, we are just a few steps away from the majestic streets of the historic centre, the Plaza Mayor, and the Royal Palace. Furthermore, you’ll enjoy proximity to renowned universities such as Complutense University of Madrid and Polytechnic University of Madrid.
At Nido Príncipe Pío, we’ve created a student accommodation environment that redefines the experience of living and studying in Madrid. Our facilities have been designed to meet all your needs, with modern study rooms, a top-notch gym, socialising spaces, private areas for relaxation, an exclusive dining area, and coworking spaces that will inspire you both academically and socially.
At Nido Príncipe Pío, we offer you much more than a place to live; we provide you with a dynamic and inclusive community that will support you during your time as a student in Madrid. Join us and enjoy a unique experience at Nido Príncipe Pío!

name: Nuevo Norte
address: Paseo de la Castellana, Madrid, Madrid 28046
about:
Live in the centre of the action. At Nuevo Norte, 78 rooms are available to provide residents with easy access to the city centre in Madrid. You can live in bright and spacious rooms, whilst being just a short journey away from one of Spain’s leading medical schools and technology university.
Classes are just a short journey away! The UAM Medical Faculty is just a 15-minute bus ride away from the building, as well as the National Research Centres for Cancer and Cardiovascular. Nuevo Norte is a perfect spot for any young medical student to call home! You also have easy access to IE Tower, the tech-focused campus of IE University.
Need somewhere quiet and private to study away from class? You can make use of our purpose-built study rooms in the building. Sit down and focus on studies, or revise with friends, you have your own personal area for studying at home.
Need to unwind after a long day on campus? You can make use of our on-site gym to work on your fitness after class. If you prefer to relax, you can also socialize in our TV area which is available to all residents.
All residents have 24-hour security services and air conditioning throughout the property. You get to live in the heart of the city, whilst also having easy access to some of the country’s top research institutes.
